Senses.Explanation: Sandal money is the expense of travelling on foot in straw sandals. In the Huangbo–Nanquan exchange, Nanquan sets gruel-water money aside and asks who will repay the sandal money; later records say a reply saves sandal money or warn against wasting it. Chan turns ordinary travel expense into an account of whether a journey or visit was worth its cost. The Record of Master Zhe’an Fan preserves his warning that someone who lightly throws away good time does not even value sandal money.
